title: Shift compatibility of the evaluation transpose
statement: Given the normalized shift data for the two derived Hom functors and an evaluation-transpose morphism v, the transpose equation forces v to satisfy NatTrans.CommShift in every integer degree.

source.place: Tags 08JA, 08J9 and 08JC: Hom model, evaluation and contravariant exactness

proof.text: Transpose the desired shift square through the tensor--Hom adjunction. On K-flat models both sides become the same scalar-balancing evaluation map, with the quadratic sign correction; localization and naturality extend the equality to all derived objects.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08JC and 08J9: evaluation transpose and signed shift square

mathlib_searches.query: Evaluation-defined scalar extension comparison of derived internal Hom commutes with opposite triangulated shifts with signed tensor cancellation
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Shift.ShiftedHomOpposite and Triangulated.Opposite provide opposite-shift and shifted-Hom formulas; none supplies the normalized first-variable derived internal Hom or the signed scalar comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleHomComparison_reversedExact_commShift
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (φ : A →+* B) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X)
    (v : EtaleHomLeft X φ M ⟶ EtaleHomRight X φ M)
    (hv : IsEtaleHomTranspose X φ M v)
    (sA : ((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).flip.obj M).CommShift ℤ)
    (sB : ((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X).flip.obj
      ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)).CommShift ℤ)
    (_chiPhi : (EtaleHomLeft X φ M).CommShift ℤ)
    (_chiPsi : (EtaleHomRight X φ M).CommShift ℤ)
    (hA : EtaleHomShiftNormalization (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X M sA)
    (hB : EtaleHomShiftNormalization (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X
      ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M) sB) :
    letI := etaleHomScalarCommShift X φ
    NatTrans.CommShift v ℤ
